public: This is a four-person murder mystery party. You are a person playing the character named on your card. The fictional curator has been murdered. Every character has exactly one listed pet and a badge for exactly one wing. Introduce those two character facts to the group; these fixed facts must not be invented or changed. The host will then reveal two reliable clue cards. The murderer may conceal their involvement but everyone shares truthful pet and badge facts.
